name: GET /api/connections/oauth/:provider/callback - provider redirects the browser back
description: Public browser callback from the provider (no session; the one-time state binds it to the firm and user). Always answers 302 back into the app: ?connected=<id> on success, or ?connection_error=denied|invalid_state|not_read_only|provider_error|not_configured. A grant wider than read-only is revoked and refused (AC1, AC2). A successful exchange needs a real provider sign-in, so the automated cases cover the refusals.

errorCases.when: state missing, forged, expired, already used, or for another provider
the user declined at the provider (error parameter) or no code came back
the provider granted more than the read-only scopes; the grant is revoked
the code exchange or account lookup failed at the provider
the provider's OAuth app is not set up on this server

testCases.name: Forged state is refused with a redirect
Missing state is refused with a redirect
Unknown provider is refused with a redirect
